test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

Sukhen always seeks to __capitalise__ on opportunities.
solution:
The solution is **forfeit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate ANTONYM for '**capitalise**' is forfeit.
 
• The word "capitalise" in this context means to take advantage of or benefit from something.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate antonym of "capitalise" from the given options would be: Forfeit
 
• **"Forfeit" means to lose or give up (something) as a necessary consequence of something else, which is the opposite of taking advantage or benefitting from something.**
 
• Therefore **option 3 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss about *antonyms*:

 
 
• Antonyms is the opposite word of the given word.
 
 
• For example:- Antonym for good id bad, Antonym for large is small.
